units.source_text: 能够外出在田里帮忙比什么都强。

en.t: Being able to go out and help in the fields is better than anything.

units.source_text: 像我家儿媳妇，嫁进门七年了，别说是田里的工作，就连除草之类的也没做过。

en.t: Take my daughter-in-law, for example. She has been married into our family for seven years, and she has never done fieldwork, not even weeding or anything like that.

units.source_text: 天天就躲在家里，给孩子洗衣服，缝补自己的衣服，混日子。”

en.t: Every day she just hides away at home, washing the children's clothes, mending her own clothes, and letting the days pass.
